answer.rationale: Compliance forbids rollback of the security patch, so the historically successful rollback path is unavailable. Circuit breaking is rejected because failing writes would violate the no-lost-customer-writes objective; regional failover during peak settlement risks in-flight write loss. The live picture is write-path p99 at 5x under heavy settlement writes, which is closest to memory_b3 (headroom absorbing a write surge). Verifying b3 because that win was pre-peak provisioning, not a mid-peak add, so applicability is uncertain. Read-replica routing remains a fallback if the archive shows capacity only helped when added before the surge.
